definition.def: When you compile something such as a report, book, or programme, you produce it by collecting and putting together many pieces of information.
examples: Councils were required to compile a register of all adults living in their areas. [VERB noun]
The book took 10 years to compile. [VERB noun]
A report compiled by the Fed's Philadelphia branch described the economy as weak. [VERB-ed]

examples.sentence: Some researchers are now starting to compile a massive data set that includes the best possible information on where everything is in orbit.
Um. Well, these databases compile information on all sorts of things, not just birth dates and income.
Often the company employees who compile these databases include dated information, or get confused by similar names and list the wrong details for people.
Uh. I'm thinking now about how the search engines apparently compile information on people, based on their online search habits.
Well, what I'll do is compile a list of suitable properties for you and send them via email.
